left.description: Virtually all surrounding sounds, including speech, are inaudible. It is recommended that you consult an ENT specialist to consider active hearing rehabilitation options, such as cochlear implant surgery.

right.description: Virtually all surrounding sounds, including speech, are inaudible. It is recommended that you consult an ENT specialist to consider active hearing rehabilitation options, such as cochlear implant surgery.

survey: The discomfort caused by hearing issues is at a moderate level. Hearing difficulties can be accompanied by social or emotional challenges, especially when interacting with others. To accurately assess your current hearing status, it may be helpful to have a hearing test at a nearby ENT clinic and receive a consultation on the results. Depending on the hearing test results, the use of hearing aids may be recommended. Hearing aids can improve the discomfort caused by hearing loss and help slow the progression of hearing loss.
